notes.title: GAME BUG(FOR MULTİPLAYER)
notes.notes: [b]HELLO FRIENDS, I HOPE YOU ENJOYED. WE FOUND ANOTHER SMALL BUG WHILE PLAYING OUR GAME. WHEN YOU TRY TO OPEN A DOOR WITHOUT ACTIVATING THE SIGNALS AND FIND THE KEYS, YOUR SCREEN WILL GET A TEXT THAT THE SIGNALS ARE NOT ACTIVE AND YOU DID NOT FIND THE KEY. SOMETIMES WHEN YOU ACTIVATE THE SIGNALS AND FIND THE KEYS, THE SAME ARTICLE CAN APPEAR ON YOUR SCREEN. GO ON YOUR WAY WITHOUT HEISING AND TRY TO FINISH THE GAME LIKE I SAID A SMALL BUG ACTUALLY YOU ACTIVATE THE SIGNALS AND FIND THE KEYS DON'T HIT THE GAME SO GOOD GAMES[/b]
